+def _rgba(color, alpha):
+    color = _normalize_color(color)
+    if color is None:
+        return None
+    if isinstance(color, str) and color.startswith("rgba("):
+        return color
+    if isinstance(color, str) and color.startswith("rgb("):
+        return color[:-1] + f", {alpha})"
+    if isinstance(color, str) and color in _NAMED_RGB:

+            hex_color = "".join(ch * 2 for ch in hex_color)
+        if len(hex_color) == 6:
+            r = int(hex_color[0:2], 16)
+            g = int(hex_color[2:4], 16)
+            b = int(hex_color[4:6], 16)
+            return f"rgba({r}, {g}, {b}, {alpha})"
+    return color

+def _band_trace(x, lower, upper, color="k", alpha=0.3, name=None):
+    x = np.asarray(x).ravel()
+    lower = np.asarray(lower).ravel()
+    upper = np.asarray(upper).ravel()
+    xs = np.concatenate([x, x[::-1]])
+    ys = np.concatenate([lower, upper[::-1]])
+    return go.Scatter(

+        line=dict(color=_rgba(color, 0.0), width=0),
+        fill="toself",
+        fillcolor=_rgba(color, alpha),
+        hoverinfo="skip",
+        name=name,
+        showlegend=False,
+    )
+
+
+def _scatter_trace_kwargs(kwargs):

+        "hovertemplate",
+        "legendgroup",
+        "marker",
+        "meta",
+        "name",
+        "opacity",
+        "showlegend",
+        "text",
+        "visible",
+    }
+    return {key: kwargs[key] for key in allowed if key in kwargs}
+
+
+def _symlog_transform(values, linthresh):
+    values = np.asarray(values)
+    return np.sign(values) * np.log1p(np.abs(values) / linthresh)
+
+
+def _symlog_ticks(values, linthresh):
+    values = np.asarray(values)
+    finite = values[np.isfinite(values)]
+    if finite.size == 0:
+        return [], []
+    candidates = [finite.min(), -linthresh, 0.0, linthresh, finite.max()]
+    seen = []
+    tickvals = []
+    ticktext = []
+    for value in candidates:
+        if value not in seen:
+            seen.append(value)
+            tickvals.append(_symlog_transform(value, linthresh))
+            ticktext.append(f"{value:g}")
+    return tickvals, ticktext
